cohort: The study included 100 patients with postdated pregnancies admitted to the obstetrics ward at a tertiary care center.
finding: Postdated pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of obstetric complications like PPH and an increased risk of neonatal intensive care unit admissions with various perinatal complications.
mod_finding: Among postdated pregnancies, 33% had vaginal delivery and 67% had cesarean delivery, with fetal distress and non-progress of labor being the major indications for cesarean section.
